source_metadata.exact_title: Differential pharmacokinetic decay of long-acting cabotegravir and rilpivirine after missed injections: a case series

extraction_limitations: The research letter does not report exact cabotegravir/rilpivirine injection doses, assay methodology, numerical HIV-1 RNA detection limit, resistance testing, or detailed per-patient concentration values in text.

Figure 1 contains paired individual concentration points, but individual values were not digitized because exact values are not labeled; only text-reported medians/ranges were normalized into quantitative atoms.
The therapeutic target concentrations and apparent elimination half-lives are literature-derived context cited by the research letter rather than estimates generated by this four-patient case series.
No correction or supplementary material was specified or used for this task.

The narrative labels prior LAI exposure of 61–393 weeks as a range, while the Figure 1 caption states that displayed summary data are median [interquartile range]; the delay is reported as median 17 weeks in text and 17.4 weeks in the figure caption. These were preserved as source-reporting ambiguities rather than reconciled by inference.
